gold.user: As a developer, I want to retrieve a list of all indexes in my Meilisearch instance so that I can manage them effectively.
gold.ideal: The response should include an array of index objects, each containing details such as indexUid, name, and number of documents.

gold.user: As a data engineer, I need to create a new index for my dataset so that I can start indexing documents.
gold.ideal: The response should confirm the creation of the index and return the indexUid along with its settings.

gold.user: As a researcher, I want to get details about a specific index to understand its configuration and status.
gold.ideal: The response should include the index's metadata, such as its uid, name, and settings.

gold.user: As a system administrator, I need to update the settings of an existing index to optimize its performance.
gold.ideal: The response should indicate success and return the updated settings of the index.

gold.user: As a product manager, I want to delete an index that is no longer needed to keep our search system clean.
gold.ideal: The response should confirm the deletion of the index and indicate that it has been removed successfully.

gold.user: As a developer, I need to swap two indexes to update the search experience without downtime.
gold.ideal: The response should confirm that the indexes have been swapped and provide the new indexUids.
